questions.q: Who created Chacha Chaudhary and wrote and drew the early stories?
questions.why: Cartoonist Pran Kumar Sharma created the red-turbaned old man and handled both story and art.

questions.q: In which Hindi magazine did Chacha Chaudhary first appear in 1971?
questions.why: The character began in the Hindi children's magazine Lotpot before becoming a Diamond Comics mainstay.

questions.q: Which publisher is best known for the Chacha Chaudhary comic books?
questions.why: Diamond Comics published Chacha Chaudhary in around ten Indian languages, selling over ten million copies.

questions.q: Chacha's giant strongman friend Sabu comes from which planet?
questions.why: Sabu is an alien from Jupiter, roughly fifteen feet tall, who supplies the muscle to Chacha's brains.

questions.q: What is the name of Chacha Chaudhary's pet dog?
questions.why: Rocket is a stray Chacha adopted, described as the only vegetarian dog in the world.

questions.q: Which character is Chacha's wife, who sometimes chases thieves with a rolling pin?
questions.why: Bini Chachi runs the household and is not above taking on robbers with her rolling pin.

questions.q: Which dacoit became immortal after accidentally drinking a potion in the Chacha Chaudhary comics?
questions.why: Raaka is the series' main villain, made immortal by an accidentally swallowed potion.

questions.q: Which actor played Chacha Chaudhary in the 2002 live-action series on Sahara One?
questions.why: Raghubir Yadav starred in the Sahara One show, which ran two seasons and 415 episodes from May 2002.

questions.q: What is the name of Chacha's truck, which is part machine and part human?
questions.why: Dag Dag is Chacha's odd half-machine, half-human truck in the comic.

questions.q: Chacha Chaudhary's brain is famously said to work faster than what?
questions.why: The signature line says his mind runs faster than a computer, which is why Chacha outwits every villain.
